{{Top|leg}}
'''Governor of Theed''' was a title given to the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] held the title of Governor of Theed during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM JN">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' junior novelization]]</ref>
